selectionNote: Selected 14 guided Kyoto d332 products with live public USD From prices, combined ratings, and unique 674x446 heroes. The live catalog supports far more than 20 tours, including additional helicopter, sake-brewery, night-walk, early-morning bike, Mount Takao hiking, and private-driver SKUs, but Viator DataDome blocking plus geo-currency dumps (EUR/ZAR/SEK/SGD/BRL/CHF) blocked many otherwise-strong pages from being verified in USD on a complete product page. No live d332 Jeep/off-road or stargazing page with combined USD+rating+hero was captured. Helicopter pages (50365P13 / 50365P11 / 50365P71) had thin reviews or Tokyo-title bleed and CHF-only dumps. Did not force audio/self-guided/app tours, inactive products, thin-review SKUs, near-duplicates, or products with unusable heroes. Same completeness constraint documented on Tokyo (11), Lima (9), Cabo San Lucas (14), Puerto Vallarta (10), Cancun (13), and Mexico City (11).
